uplink._note: Per-position truth vector, derived from reference/upstream-codec.js parseStandardPayload. bytes[0]=46=0b00101110: DIN1=bit0=0 (din0 open), DIN2=bit1=1 (din1 closed), DIN3=bit2=1 (din2 closed), WKUP=bit3=1. ADC1=((46&0xf0)>>4)=2 | (77<<4)=1232 => 1234 (adc0); ADC2=(136&0x0f)<<8=2048 | bytes[2]=0 => 2048 (adc1); ADC3=((136&0xf0)>>4)=8 | (187<<4)=2992 => 3000 (adc2). Battery=((67&0x0f)=3)<<8 | 132 => 900 * 4 = 3600 mV => 3.6 V. Temperature: bytes[7]=253 has bit7 set, raw = ((67&0xf0)>>4)=4 | (253<<4)=4048 => 4052, (4096-4052)*0.125*-1 = -5.5 C. Modbus0 = bytes[9]<<8 | bytes[8] = 18<<8 | 52 = 4660 (0x1234).
